description_nl: key_fields: the per-person key form, one entry per stored field — label, secret (a secret is never sent back, whitespace and control characters are stripped from it), used_by, where (where to get one); the model field's choices come from store.models, other_ok lets a newer model be typed. A key belongs to the PERSON: no portal-wide key. model_field: the field checked as a model id. default_provider: whose balance funds are read for. mask_dots / mask_tail / mask_min_length: a key longer than the minimum shows as dots plus its last characters, a shorter one as dots only. runs_kept: the receipt roll keeps this many runs. A bill is summed from it, so it must be long enough to cover the longest gap between bills.
